_about: Every gameplay number lives here. Speeds in m/s, times in seconds, wobble from 0 (steady) to 1 (a kid falls out).

wobble._flashAt: the HUD wobble bar flashes above this (the kids fall out at 1)
wobble._coCarry: while two coats carry one piece of loot together, every wobble fill is multiplied by this (steadier than alone)
wobble._whySeconds: how long the one-line reason ("Slipped on a puddle!") stays on the HUD after kids fall out

slippery._about: patchSeconds null = the mess stays for the whole job. A slip is a short skid: after skidMax metres of sliding the coat brakes with brakeGrip (M1-F8: testers slid 10 to 20 m)

aimHelp._about: M1-F9: a shot at a grown-up inside cone radians (either side of the cursor) and range m goes at them: lead x their walking speed x the flight time ahead, lifted to arrive at chest height (m), and its spread multiplied by spread

unstack._about: warnDistance/warnSeconds: R with a grown-up watching within warnDistance m only warns (hint line); R again within warnSeconds unstacks anyway

things._about: how things behave on the mess and in your hands

events._about: timed events per job (seconds after the start)

suspicion._about: the "?" meter each grown-up has for each coat, 0..1 per second; full = THAT'S NOT A GROWN-UP!

heat._about: Heat for the whole job: points from busts and shouts; level = how many thresholds are passed (0 Calm, 1 Twitchy, 2 Alert, 3 Panic). Several grown-ups catching you in the same moment (within sameIncident seconds) count as one incident: the first adds 'bust', the others 'bustSameIncident'.

closingTime._about: seconds into the job, then one section every sectionEvery seconds, with a warning first

gadgetsOnCoat._about: what gadget effects do to a coat (friendly fire)

loot._about: pockets hold this many small pieces; big loot slows you by perKg (down to minSpeed of normal); every drop loses dropLoss of the value, never below minValue of the original

job._about: cleanBonus: +50% for finishing at Heat 0; gateWarnSeconds: after the 'kids still inside!' warning at the gate, E again within this many seconds leaves them behind

rescue._about: solo players get spareKids per run instead of friends; a Spare Kid comes in as one kid through the open door (spareDoors: spawn list in the place file, Closing Time section that shuts it) that the fewest grown-ups can see, and grown-ups ignore it for spareSafe seconds. gateReach = how close you must be to open the cage.

breather._about: after a grown-up grabs a kid the shop takes a breath: for seconds, nobody else starts a chase or a shout and no '?' fills; everyone not carrying a kid forgets who they busted (their '?' drops to susAfter at most); Heat drops one level, at most once every heatDropEvery seconds

shop._about: Dodgy Del's stall in the alley, between jobs. Sweets banked in a job (with the Clean Job / Chaos bonus) go in the team's sweet jar; Del takes them. Prices in sweets. Buying a gadget you already have doubles up its ammo. A run ends when everyone is caught: the jar empties and everyone starts again with the starter gadgets.

drinks._about: Fizzy drinks, F (right bumper) to drink the first one you're carrying.

giggles._about: Giggles: the game rewards being funny. Each funny moment adds Giggles to the team's meter; a full meter starts a team Sugar Rush (everyone faster, endless ammo) and empties it. A chain is signals that follow each other closely (each within chain.range metres and chain.gap seconds of the last ones); a Domino is one chain flooring domino.min or more grown-ups. Small Giggles for single pranks (firstSoak: the first time each grown-up gets soaked in a job; burpKnock: a burp that floors someone; peelSlip: a grown-up slipping on your banana peel), so the meter fills about once a job for a playful team. FRIENDLY FIRE (soakFriend) counts once per friend per soakFriend.every seconds. Labels: data/giggles.json.
